evidence.detail: The constructor writes the exact surviving overlay identity literal 'CombatOverlay' into the shared client-overlay base, fixing the class noun directly.
The class extends the shared positioned overlay base, configures overlay placement/layer behavior, returns zero dimensions when hidden, and otherwise renders one bounded combat-status surface.

The overlay stores a target name and entity index, resolves that index to live NPC or player state, validates the resolved entity name against the stored target, and derives current combat/health state from that entity.

It stores maximum/current combat values plus an animated display value, derives the proportional bar width, handles recent damage interpolation, and renders the target label together with current/max values on the combat bar.

Rendering requires a non-null target name, positive maximum value and a recent update timestamp; the overlay expires after 20 seconds and is additionally suppressed by exact client/interface visibility state.

candidates.note: CombatOverlay is fixed by the exact surviving 'CombatOverlay' identity literal and a complete single-purpose target/health/progress render lifecycle. This client-native overlay is distinct from the separately reviewed CombatOverlaysPlugin/config subsystem. Confidence is 0.999.
